name: B10-0400/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION OF CENSURE ON THE COMMISSION MOTION OF CENSURE ON THE COMMISSION
part_text:
A group of Members of the European Parliament is asking Parliament to formally censure the European Commission. If adopted, this would be a formal vote of no confidence in the Commission. The motion lists complaints: green policies harming competitiveness, financial scandals, lack of transparency, failure to stop illegal migration, threats to free speech, and trade deals with Mercosur and the United States made without proper approval. It does not change any law itself; it is a political challenge to the Commission.

- The motion calls for a formal censure vote on the Commission; no law changes.
- It targets the Commission and its President over economic, migration, free speech and trade complaints.
- Parliament votes on it; if passed, the Commission would have to resign.
